name: Westchester County, New York (United States)
description: Divided horizontally orange over blue, with a large white triangle whose base takes up the whole hoist, bearing the county emblem in blue within a ring of stars, and Westchester County, New York in white on the blue.
history: Westchester County is a suburban county north of New York City. The original flag was adopted on 1 May 1939 by the county's Committee on Budget and Appropriations after a citizens' committee selected the design; the colours recall the Dutch tricolour. Wikidata dates the present version, with the county's name added, from 1985.
